_spec_ref: PROJECT_META v3, Teil B.5 - an explicit decision is MANDATORY; silent omission is disallowed.
rationale: No FX process is modelled. The only claim this project still tests (Phase 6, GOLD downside) is mu-neutral by pre-registration and rests exclusively on second moments and tax mechanics. An FX process would require a correlation structure between currency and asset returns that is subject to the same underdetermination as G6, and would therefore add model uncertainty without making the claim more decidable.
cost_borne: The EUR investor's unhedged USD / JPY / EM currency exposure is OUT OF SCOPE. Asset processes are interpreted as EUR-denominated total returns with the FX component folded into their volatility rather than modelled as a separate correlated factor. Any statement about the currency risk of a satellite is therefore NOT SUPPORTED by this model.
mandatory_disclosure: This decision MUST be restated verbatim in every result report, per B.5.
